business_problem: Danske Statsbaner (DSB), the largest rail operator in Denmark and Scandinavia, wanted to find ways GenAI could help solve a variety of operational issues, including the proliferation of graffiti in tunnels and on trains.
solution_summary: Danske Statsbaner (DSB) built this solution on Microsoft 365 Copilot. Danske Statsbaner (DSB), the largest rail operator in Denmark and Scandinavia, wanted to find ways GenAI could help solve a variety of operational issues, including the proliferation of graffiti in tunnels and on trains. Microsoft 365 Copilot assists employees with drafting, summarization, and information retrieval inside daily work tools. DSB adopted Microsoft AI technologies, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, as part of an effort to centralize data and make the development of new data-based solutions—including AI solutions—easier. We saw huge potential in using GenAI when it first came out,” says Friis. Documents, meetings, and collaboration context remain in Microsoft 365 while Copilot generates grounded drafts, summaries, and answers directly inside daily employee workflows.
